ThingDef.label: Ancient shield harmonic prism
ThingDef.description: An inert, damaged precursor calibration prism recovered from a mature shield system. It projects no usable barrier, but surviving phase geometry preserves an Ancient reference for high-energy shield harmonics. It must be analyzed before a stronger gravship emitter can be reconstructed. The current relic visual is provisional pending the professional art pass.

li.activateDescString: Map the surviving phase relationships in this inert Ancient shield-calibration relic.
li.completedLetter: The recovered prism's surviving phase geometry has been mapped. The relic remains inert, but it now provides a genuine Ancient reference for reconstructing a high-energy gravship shield.
